sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: The controls bar beside the page heading is now three groups instead of one long run of buttons. On an artist's Events page it went from 13 controls — nine of them carrying a text label, wrapping onto two lines on a normal window — to five.

📦 Data ▾ holds 💾 Save to Disk, 📂 Load from Disk and 💾 Export. 🛠 View ▾ holds 📏 Density, 📊 Statistics, the barcode-highlight toggle and 🎹 Keyboard shortcuts. Each row shows its own keyboard shortcut on the right, and the menus are navigable with ↑/↓/Home/End, closed with Escape or a click outside.
⚙️ Settings and ❓ Help stay pinned in the bar, one click away as before: they are what you reach for when something is wrong, and burying them would be the opposite of the point.

↔️ Resize and 👁️ Visible moved out of the bar altogether, to the table's own heading beside the filter box — glyph-only, exactly where the per-sub-table ↔️/👁️ pair has always been on a multi-table page. They act on one table, so they now sit next to it. Tooltips and keyboard shortcuts are unchanged.

On an artist's release-group page the four discography views are now one 📀 Discography ▾ menu, and its button names the view you are in — "📀 Discography: Official". The flat run could only tint the active button, which told you nothing until you had looked at all four. That page has the widest heading the script renders; this removes five slots from it.
Every control kept its keyboard shortcut and its tooltip. Pressing Ctrl+D, Ctrl+E or Ctrl+S opens the owning menu for you rather than reporting that the button is missing.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: New setting "Toolbar menu button colors" under 🖌️ ELEMENT UI STYLES, matching the existing per-button colour settings.
The three " | " separators the old bar used are gone; only the one between the fetch buttons and the tools remains, because it still separates two different things.
